canonical_context.reason: Migrate retired data-qualified POSIX helper declarations and all their authored callers to ordinary free machines with unchanged explicit parameters, contracts, target bodies and state. No name fallback or receiver insertion.
passages:
Named decision: `no-data-code-attachment`, ratified 2026-10-22. A data declaration
is not a machine owner or namespace. Declaring a machine under a data carrier,
such as `machine Counter::increment`, is retired even with an explicit parameter.
Machine qualification identifies an ordinary module, trait requirement, named
implementation or lexically visible nested declaration; it never binds code to a data type. Package visibility and exact
declaration identity remain independent of the types of explicit arguments.

canonical_context.reason: Complete the declaration migration by making authored ordinary and terminal calls acknowledge their already computed blocking envelope exactly. Preserve all effects, explicit parameters and native behavior; private nesting supplies no marker exemption.
passages:
Nested machine calls have no marker exemption. Their exact call envelope
determines `suspend` and `block`, including in terminal position, even when
lowering later implements the call with a jump. Markers do not redirect name
resolution. Missing, partial or redundant call markers reject under
[effects](effects.md#call-site-acknowledgements). The same
[borrow/carry requirements](../resources/carry.md#borrows-across-suspension)
apply in a terminal arm as at any other suspending call.
